question.text: USDINR spot is 82.80. For options at the 83 strike, what is the intrinsic value of the call and the put?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook gives call intrinsic value as max(spot - strike, 0) and put intrinsic value as max(strike - spot, 0). With spot 82.80 and strike 83.00: call intrinsic = max(82.80 - 83.00, 0) = 0 (OTM); put intrinsic = max(83.00 - 82.80, 0) = 0.20 (ITM). The Trap: Premium is not the same as intrinsic value; intrinsic value depends only on spot versus strike, while premium also includes time value. Note: Workbook references — pp.70-71 (intrinsic value formula for calls and puts) and p.83 (long-put payoff diagram and ITM/OTM examples).
